overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Department of Correction and its committees are exempt under G.L. c. 30A, § 1A, so the minutes complaint was closed as resolved.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Department failed to provide minutes from its Religious Committee, Religious Services Review Committee, and Inmate Property Committee.
